name: NH Collection Madrid Gran Vía
description: The newly opened NH Collection Madrid Gran Vía is in the heart of one of Madrid's most iconic streets. This city center hotel is in an ideal location for shopping at designer boutiques, as well as exploring Gran Vía's restaurants, coffee shops, book stores and cocktail bars. The hotel is within walking distance of Madrid's central attractions, including La Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Plaza España, Plaza de Cibeles and the Prado museum. It's also near Gran Vía underground station and around one hour from the airport. The hotel's 94 elegantly decorated rooms each have Nespresso machines and free Wi-Fi. Accommodation includes Superior rooms, Premium rooms and Junior suites. Guests will enjoy a refreshing night's sleep on new mattresses with a choice of pillows. Start the day with our a la carte breakfast, featuring international favorites including breads, pastries, fruit and hot dishes, as well as local specialties like Spanish sausage. One of the highlights of this Madrid city center hotel is the 8th floor roof terrace with spectacular views over Gran Vía, and watched over by the Titan god Atlas. Here you'll find the restaurant, Picalagartos, with a menu of Spanish classics with a twist. Bar service includes snacks and cocktails designed by top bartenders.
